title: Design: long tier names in grid headers are cut with an ellipsis
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Tier).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a long name with no spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingTierPlanX).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Point at tier B's column header.
  4. Point at tier C's column header.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's and tier B's headers show the start of their names cut short with "…".
  • Every column keeps its width and the grid does not grow wider.
  • The columns keep the layout of picture 3.2.

Step 3:

  • Tier B's full name shows on hover.

Step 4:

  • Tier C's full name shows on hover character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.
